name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides an Nginx multisite web server for three cluster-local hostnames, including document roots, static pages, SSL virtual hosts, self-signed certificates, and service management.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, runtime and logging directories, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application from GitHub with Python dependencies, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a Uvicorn systemd service.
